title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
lineage: gen 1 cassette> tascam mkII>Korg MR1000 at 1bit/5.6mHZ>Korg Audio Gate Software>32 bit float/192kHz>Wavelab 6.1 for fades, blank tape removal, and slight channel adjustment>Weiss-Saracon for 24 bit fixed/196kHz Pow-r3 Dither

ai_review.summary: Rare uncut Steven > It's a Sin > Steven from the 1969 Boston show shines with a fascinating Dark Star; soundboard recording is good for its age but not perfectly clean.
ai_review.review: The partial sound‑board capture delivers an exciting early Dead performance, highlighted by a rare uncut Steven > It's a Sin > Steven sequence and a fat, alive Garcia on Dark Star. Reviewers praise the musical energy and note that, while the audio is impressive for a 1969 source, it could benefit from a light EQ cleanup. One listener reported playback failure, giving the overall impression of mixed technical reliability.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews praise both performance and recording (good show, decent sound); a single 0‑star note cites a playback issue, leading to an overall strong but slightly tempered rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and lively for its era; reviewers note age‑related artifacts and suggest minor EQ cleanup. One user could not play the file, indicating a possible file integrity issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial set captures a rare uncut sequence and early‑Dead improvisational energy, with strong transitions noted by fans.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's SG tone described as fat, alive, and fascinating on Dark Star.
